name: Flare gas recovery and smokeless flares
principle: Elevated flares burn relief and vent gas at the tip of a stack 10 to over 100 m tall, using steam or air assistance for smokeless burning; ground flares burn at ground level, often in enclosures. EPA's AP-42 says properly operated flares achieve at least 98% destruction efficiency, with refinery flares needing at least 270 Btu/ft3 net heating value in the combustion zone. Flare gas recovery compressors return routine flow to fuel gas; see the upstream flare gas recovery card.
